# anthropic_rbac_group (Resource)

Manages a Claude Enterprise RBAC group (`/v1/organizations/rbac_groups?beta=true`). Supports creating and renaming custom API groups (`source_type = "api"`) and importing SCIM-synced groups (`source_type = "scim"`). Note that `role_ids` is read-only (Computed) because the Anthropic Admin API only accepts `name` on create and update; role assignments to groups are configured in the Claude Enterprise UI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_rbac_roles" "all" {}

# Manage an API-created Claude Enterprise RBAC group
resource "anthropic_rbac_group" "security_engineers" {
  name     = "Security-Engineers"
  role_ids = [for r in data.anthropic_rbac_roles.all.roles : r.id if r.name == "Claude Code User"]
}

resource "anthropic_rbac_group_member" "alice" {
  group_id = anthropic_rbac_group.security_engineers.id
  user_id  = "user_01J9ABCDEF"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the RBAC group. Cannot be modified for SCIM-provisioned groups (`source_type = "scim"`).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the group was created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the RBAC group.
- `role_ids` (Set of String) Read-only set of RBAC role IDs currently assigned to this group in Claude Enterprise.
- `source_type` (String) Provisioning source of the group (e.g., `api` or `scim`).
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the group was last updated.
